name: Cerulean Invasion: Aftermath
source:
Experience the story through three distinct perspectives: Osman, Evan, and Alexis. Witness their personal growth as they move forward in different ways. Some form new connections, others deepen existing bonds, and some must confront the consequences left behind by the events of Cerulean Invasion.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4400750/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
从奥斯曼、埃文与亚历克西斯三名截然不同的视角体验故事，见证他们各自以不同的方式迈步前行、实现蜕变与成长。有人缔结了崭新的羁绊，有人加深了原有的情谊，也有人必须直面《蔚蓝入侵》事件落幕后遗留的种种后果。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4400750/]Steam[/url]]
